c027.title: Around Kyiv by metro
c027.story: Anna's cousin Taras is her [[visitor]] today. It is his first [[visit]] to Kyiv. Anna loves public [[transport]], so they take the [[metro]]. An [[inspector]] checks their tickets. The long [[escalator]] takes them to the city [[center]]. They walk down a [[downtown]] [[avenue]] to the [[park]]. Taras takes photos of a big [[monument]]. Next to it is a quiet [[memorial]] with flowers. Then they walk along a green [[boulevard]]. The [[promenade]] by the river is their last stop. "Excuse me, mister, your wallet!" a woman calls. Taras says thank you and smiles.

c030.title: Booking a hotel for the weekend
c030.story: Max looks for a cheap weekend in Lviv. A [[hostel]] is cheap, but the rooms are shared. A [[motel]] is for drivers on the road. A [[resort]] costs too much. So Max finds a small [[hotel]]. His [[booking]] is for four people [[maximum]]. The [[minimum]] stay is two nights. A [[no-show]] costs a fee. On Friday at [[reception]], [[check-in]] takes two minutes [[max]]. They get the [[Wi-Fi]] password and a phone [[adapter]]. Max's old speaker needs a [[converter]] too. [[Check-out|check-out]] is at eleven on Sunday.

c031.title: A night in a luxury hotel
c031.story: Anna wins a night in a [[luxury]] hotel in a radio competition. A smiling [[concierge]] meets her in the [[foyer]]. They walk through a big [[hall]] and down a long [[corridor]]. "This is a [[deluxe]] room," he says. The bed is [[king-size]], even bigger than a [[queen-size]] bed. There is a [[jacuzzi]] in the bathroom too. In the evening she tries the [[spa]]. First she gets a back [[massage]], then she relaxes in the [[sauna]]. Everything is [[premium]], and even the coffee machine is [[high-end]]. In the morning she orders breakfast from [[room service]]. She sends Max a photo: "I never want to go home!"

c032.title: Max's new scooter
c032.story: Max wants to get to college faster. A [[moped]] is too noisy, so he buys an electric [[scooter]]. On Monday he rides on the smooth [[asphalt]] by the river. A [[biker]] on a loud motorcycle passes him. Max goes faster and forgets the speed [[limit]]. In a dark [[tunnel]] he almost hits a [[bicycle]]. Luckily, he sees its red [[reflector]] just in time. The cyclist stops, her foot still on the [[pedal]]. "Slow down!" she shouts. After this [[incident]], Max rides slowly. On weekends he goes [[biking]] in the forest on his [[mountain bike]].

c033.title: Dad buys a car
c033.story: Anna's dad is a car [[enthusiast]]. He watches every [[grand prix]] on TV. Now he wants a new [[automobile]] for the family. On Saturday they go to an [[auto]] dealer with a big [[showroom]]. Dad stops next to a red [[supercar]]. Then he looks at a long white [[limousine]]. "Too expensive, Dad," Anna laughs. So he chooses between a [[sedan]] and a [[diesel]] [[minivan]]. Anna's driving instructor comes too and listens to the [[motor]]. Dad takes the minivan for a [[test drive]]. Then he asks the manager about [[leasing]]. Next week the family drives home in a new car.
